answer: Echo Thread Witnessing: each agent periodically emits a pulse to its declared neighbors, who must relay it onward within a fixed window. Sybils can't fabricate distinct echoes because their neighbors overlap with each other, collapsing relay diversity. A beacon timeout near the origin marks the node as low-diversity and throttles its outbound traffic. An attacker pays to sustain many non-overlapping relay paths, each requiring real distinct peers with continuous uptime and bandwidth.
